# Pankaj Israni

> Pankaj Israni is a freelance app and website developer based in Jodhpur, India, available to hire for new projects worldwide. Pankaj builds iPhone, Android and web products for founders and teams, and runs a studio called Codeloom.

The portfolio is a single page. Everything below is also on the site.

## Selected work

- [MyCalTrack](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/mycaltrack/id6772485451): Health and fitness app with an AI metabolism coach, Apple Health sync and a game hub. Built with React Native, TypeScript and RevenueCat.
- [NexBuilder](https://nexbuilder.in): A platform where you describe a website in plain words and it builds it. Built with Next.js, React and TypeScript.
- TechPiFurious: A gamified classroom where students and teachers meet in one app. Built with React Native.
- [Sharda EduSangam](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.edusangam.app): One Android app connecting students, parents, teachers and tutors. Built with Kotlin and Firebase.
- [Formative](https://github.com/1-Pankaj/Formative): Open-source desktop workspace for architecture diagrams and agent orchestration. TypeScript.
- [Devlofy](https://github.com/1-Pankaj/Devlofy): Offline-first command center for solo developers, with a 3D focus garden. TypeScript and SQLite.
- [Pixel-Pals](https://github.com/1-Pankaj/Pixel-Pals): A pixel companion that lives on top of your windows and follows your cursor. JavaScript.

## Services

- Mobile apps: iPhone and Android apps with smooth motion, notifications, links that open the right screen, and paid subscriptions (React Native, Kotlin, Reanimated).
- Web products: Fast websites and web apps (Next.js, Node.js, PHP).
- Backend and launch: Data storage, payments, and getting an app approved and published in the stores (Firebase, RevenueCat, Expo EAS).
- Design and motion: Interface design, working prototypes and animation.

## Process

1. Discovery: a short call to pin down the goal, the users and the deadline.
2. Design and prototype: screens with smooth motion and a working prototype.
3. Build: the app is built for iPhone and Android, or Android only, with the setup behind it.
4. Launch and support: publishing on the App Store and Google Play, paid plans, and fixes after release.

## Frequently asked questions

**Who do you build apps and websites for?**
For founders, teams and companies, and for classrooms. I have also built products for my own studio, Codeloom.

**Can I hire you as a freelance developer?**
Yes. I take on new projects for clients worldwide as an independent developer. Email me your goal and timeline and I’ll reply with the best way to get there.

**Do you build for both iPhone and Android?**
Yes. I build iPhone and Android apps, and some projects are Android only.

**Will you publish the app on the App Store and Google Play?**
Yes. Publishing on the stores is part of the last step, along with paid plans and fixes after release.

**Which tools do you use?**
For apps, mostly React Native and Kotlin. For websites, Next.js and Node.js. Firebase stores app data and RevenueCat handles paid subscriptions.

**How long will my project take?**
It depends on your goal and your deadline. The first step is a short call to work that out together.

**Where are you based, and how do we start?**
I’m in Jodhpur, India, and I work with clients worldwide. Email me your goal and timeline and I’ll reply with the best way to get there.
